blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The point of the House prosecution panel was not the value of the firearms of Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, Manases Carpio, but whether they were properly disclosed in her sworn statement of assets, liabilities, and net worth, former Rep. Robert Ace Barbers, House prosecution adviser and spokesperson, said on Monday. In a post-trial news briefing, Barbers pointed out that the vice president, if she really had a net worth of P98 million, would be able to afford P7 million.
